sections.title: How the population has changed in North Warwickshire
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, North Warwickshire was the 30th largest local authority in the West Midlands, with a population of just over 67,000. Its population increased by 1.1% compared with 2023, and has increased by 8.6% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the West Midlands, 2001-2024
Population density in North Warwickshire
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in North Warwickshire was 236 people per square kilometre, which was less than the West Midlands (476), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the West Midlands, 2024
Median age in North Warwickshire
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in North Warwickshire was 44 years, which was older than the West Midlands (39 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
